requirement_text.REQ-124: MOB-2 (docs/mobile/requirements.md) needs GET /tenant-config to return { realm_url, locales, default_locale, branding, environment_kind } WITHOUT a bearer token: the mobile app calls it to discover which realm to authenticate against, so by definition it has no token yet. Verified against lib/ on 2026-08-21, this is two gaps, not one: (a) Letflow.Routers.TenantConfig is a stub whose routes land in REQ-078; and (b) Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline mounts it behind Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline, so implementing the route is not sufficient -- it would still demand the token the caller cannot have. Resolve (b) explicitly: either an unauthenticated variant mounted ahead of AuthPipeline, or a documented exemption inside it. Pick one and record why in the moduledoc. This is the gate for the entire mobile tier -- without it the app cannot reach a login screen -- which is why it is sequenced first in docs/mobile/build-order.md phase M-0. Security scope: an unauthenticated endpoint returning per-tenant data is a tenant-data path by definition and needs SECURITY-REVIEWER. The response must expose only what bootstrap requires. Check the shape field-by-field against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md -- in particular whether an unauthenticated caller enumerating slugs can learn which tenants exist, and what the answer should be for a slug that does not exist.

result.summary: Re-verified: the sole prior FAIL finding (duplicated safe_get_tenant_by_slug/1 rescue/log wrapper across the two routers) is resolved. grep across lib/ confirms exactly one rescue clause now exists, in Letflow.Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2; the only other hits are the two call sites (tenant_config.ex:171, mobile_tenant_config.ex:170) and a stale reference inside the pre-implementation design doc (lib/letflow/design/req124-mobile-tenant-config.md), which is not live code and not a duplicate. The hoist is idiomatic: it lives on Letflow.Identity (the context module both routers already alias for get_tenant_by_slug/1), keeps the never-raise/never-log-the-exception contract (INV-4) in exactly one place, and takes a context_label parameter so each caller's log lines stay distinguishable -- a clean shared-context-function shape, not a macro/behaviour/new abstraction layer, so no scope creep. @spec and @doc are present and accurate. git diff main...HEAD scoped to the three artifacts_in files shows only: (1) the hoisted function + `require Logger` added to identity.ex, (2) tenant_config.ex's private wrapper deleted and its one call site repointed to Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2, (3) mobile_tenant_config.ex's own copy deleted and repointed identically -- no other behavior change. Everything previously approved and unchanged by this diff: the two-module split (mobile_tenant_config.ex is untouched except the wrapper deletion), both moduledocs' reasoning and INV-2 response allowlists (5-key mobile map, 2-key web map, both hand-built, no %Tenant{} derivation), and router.ex's mount order (/api/mobile/tenant-config declared after /api/tenant-config, still before /api/v1, ahead of AuthPipeline) -- router.ex's diff is purely additive and matches what this pass's first review already covered. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` exits 0.
